summary:
Lord of Tresserhorn is a 10/4 for four with a harsh enter trigger. The deck suppresses or counters that trigger, then kills with infect (Phyresis, Tainted Strike, Kediss spreading poison to the table), 22 double-strike commander damage, or Gravecrawler and Skeleton loops. This review re-verifies all 21 attestation items. Nineteen Spellbook lines are confirmed.

One flag: Lightning Greaves' shroud blocks the deck's own Lord-targeting kill spells. Rules surprises: Lord himself is the Zombie that enables Gravecrawler; Kediss works from the 99; Pain for All triggers even on lethal damage.

interactions.title: The enter trigger: life loss, two sacrifices (possibly Lord), opponent draws
interactions.ruling: On resolution you lose 2 life (it's loss, not a payment, so it can take you below 0), sacrifice two creatures, and the target opponent draws two. With zero or one other creature, Lord himself is one of the two. Regeneration can't save him from a sacrifice. The rest still happens.
interactions.short: ETB: lose 2, sacrifice two creatures (Lord too if needed; regeneration doesn't help), opponent draws two.

oracle.quote: When Lord of Tresserhorn enters, you lose 2 life, you sacrifice two creatures, and target opponent draws two cards.

rulings.quote: When Lord of Tresserhorn enters, if you have zero or one other creature on the battlefield, Lord of Tresserhorn itself will be sacrificed as part of its ability's effect. Regeneration won't save it. The rest of the effect still happens.
Since this is a loss of life and not a payment, your life total can be reduced below zero by this.

source.item: Lord of Tresserhorn enters trigger and sacrifice requirement

interactions.title: Turning off the drawback: Torpor Orb, Karn, Dress Down, Stifle, Tale's End
interactions.ruling: Torpor Orb or Karn, Argent Defender already in play means Lord's entry never triggers. If Karn enters at the same time as Lord, Lord's trigger is still suppressed. Dress Down only works if it's out before Lord enters; it can't remove a trigger already on the stack. While it's out, Lord also loses regeneration and any abilities granted before Dress Down entered. Abilities granted after it (Tainted Strike's infect, Uncaged Fury's double strike) stay, so plan the kill turn around it. Dress Down is sacrificed at end step. Stifle or Tale's End counters the trigger itself.
interactions.short: Torpor/Karn/Dress Down must be in place first; Stifle/Tale's End counter the trigger.

oracle.quote: Artifacts and creatures entering the battlefield don't cause abilities to trigger.

rulings.quote: If Karn, Argent Defender and another artifact or creature enter the battlefield at the same time, neither one will cause triggered abilities to trigger when they enter the battlefield.
If an effect grants a creature an ability after Dress Down has entered the battlefield, it won't lose that ability.

source.item: Torpor Orb and Karn, Argent Defender suppress Lord
Dress Down suppresses Lord only when sequenced before entry
Stifle and Tale's End counter Lord's triggered ability

interactions.title: Regeneration only replaces destruction
interactions.ruling: {B} gives a regeneration shield that replaces Lord's next destruction this turn: lethal damage (Blasphemous Act) or 'destroy'. It doesn't help against sacrifice, toughness 0 or less, or -X/-X like Toxic Deluge.

source.item: Regeneration limitations

interactions.title: Haste: sacrifice Anger to Lord's own trigger, or use Arena of Glory
interactions.ruling: Sacrifice Anger as one of the two creatures. With a Mountain-typed land, Anger in the graveyard gives Lord haste right away. Exerted Arena of Glory mana spent on Lord also gives haste.

oracle.quote: As long as this card is in your graveyard and you control a Mountain, creatures you control have haste.

source.item: Anger plus Lord's own sacrifice trigger
Arena of Glory haste

interactions.title: Infect Lord: Tainted Strike or Phyresis, then Kediss
interactions.ruling: Lord is 10/4. Phyresis gives infect: ten poison from one hit. Tainted Strike makes him 11 power with infect. Kediss (in the 99, not a partner commander here) triggers when any commander you control deals combat damage to an opponent. Lord then deals that much to each other opponent, and with infect still on, that's poison too: a table kill. Kediss's damage isn't combat damage, so it doesn't count toward commander damage or retrigger Kediss.
interactions.short: Phyresis/Tainted Strike + Kediss: one connection gives every opponent 10+ poison.

oracle.quote: Whenever a commander you control deals combat damage to an opponent, it deals that much damage to each other opponent.

rulings.quote: The damage the commander deals as a result of Kediss's triggered ability isn't combat damage. It isn't tracked with combat damage dealt by commanders and won't cause Kediss's ability to trigger again.
Kediss's triggered ability will trigger if any commander you control deals combat damage to an opponent, not just your commander.

spellbook.quote: Deal combat damage with Lord of Tresserhorn, causing target opponent to get eleven poison counters.
Kediss triggers, causing your commander to give each other opponent at least ten poison counters due to its infect.

source.item: Tainted Strike and Phyresis infect conversion
Kediss infect spread

interactions.title: Noncombat infect: Chandra's Ignition and Pain for All
interactions.ruling: Chandra's Ignition on an infect Lord deals 10 (11 with Tainted Strike) infect damage to each opponent, so poison everywhere with no combat. Pain for All's enter trigger hits one target for his power. Its second trigger fires even on lethal damage. With a regeneration shield, Blasphemous Act's 13 to Lord becomes 13 to each opponent, as poison if he has infect.

oracle.quote: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to each other creature and each opponent.
Whenever enchanted creature is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to each opponent.

rulings.quote: If lethal damage is dealt to the enchanted creature, Pain for All’s last ability still triggers.

source.item: Chandra's Ignition with infect
Pain for All immediate and reflected damage

interactions.title: Uncaged Fury: 22 commander damage
interactions.ruling: Uncaged Fury makes Lord 11/5 with double strike. If both damage steps hit the same opponent, that's 22 combat damage from a commander, past the 21 threshold.

oracle.quote: Target creature gets +1/+1 and gains double strike until end of turn.

source.item: Uncaged Fury commander-damage kill

interactions.title: Lightning Greaves' shroud blocks your own Lord spells; Brotherhood Regalia doesn't
interactions.ruling: Brotherhood Regalia gives ward {2} (opponents only) and unblockable, and equips a legendary creature for {1}, so you can still target Lord. Lightning Greaves gives shroud, which stops your own Tainted Strike, Uncaged Fury, Chandra's Ignition, Pain for All and Slip Out the Back. Move Greaves first. Swiftfoot Boots' hexproof doesn't have this problem.

flag.note: Pilot note, not a list error: Lightning Greaves' shroud blocks the deck's own Lord-targeting kill spells (Tainted Strike, Uncaged Fury, Chandra's Ignition, Pain for All, Slip Out the Back). Re-equip Greaves to another creature before the kill turn; Boots and Regalia don't conflict.

oracle.quote: Equipped creature has ward {2}, is an Assassin in addition to its other types, and can't be blocked.

source.item: Brotherhood Regalia versus Whispersilk Cloak

interactions.title: Not of This World and Slip Out the Back protect Lord
interactions.ruling: Not of This World costs {7} less when it counters a spell or ability that targets Lord with power 7 or more. That's normally free, and it can target abilities, not just spells. Slip Out the Back puts a +1/+1 counter on Lord and phases him out with his Auras and Equipment. Phasing isn't leaving the battlefield, so there are no leave or enter triggers and he keeps the counter. He's removed from combat if attacking.

oracle.quote: This spell costs {7} less to cast if it targets a spell or ability that targets a creature you control with power 7 or greater.

rulings.quote: As a creature is phased out, Auras and Equipment attached to it also phase out at the same time. Those Auras and Equipment will phase in at the same time that creature does, and they'll phase in still attached to that creature.
An attacking or blocking creature that phases out is removed from combat.

source.item: Not of This World cost reduction
Slip Out the Back protection and counter retention

interactions.title: Rooftop Storm makes Lord cost {0} plus tax
interactions.ruling: Lord is a Zombie, so Rooftop Storm's {0} alternative cost applies. Commander tax is an additional cost and is still paid on top. Mana value doesn't change.

rulings.quote: The mana cost and mana value of the spell are unchanged. Rooftop Storm only changes what you pay.

source.item: Rooftop Storm and commander tax

interactions.title: Gravecrawler loops (Lord himself is the other Zombie)
interactions.ruling:
Gravecrawler can be cast from the graveyard while you control a Zombie, and Lord of Tresserhorn is one. Loops:
- Rooftop Storm makes it free with any sacrifice outlet (Bombardment kills directly).
- Pitiless Plunderer's Treasure pays the {B} when sacrificing to Phyrexian Altar, Ashnod's Altar, Viscera Seer or Carrion Feeder.
- Warren Soultrader (1 life) plus Blood Artist or Zulaport (gain 1) is life-neutral and drains.
Plunderer triggers on any other creature you control dying, tokens included.
interactions.short: Gravecrawler + Rooftop Storm/Plunderer + outlet; Lord counts as the needed Zombie.

oracle.quote: You may cast this card from your graveyard as long as you control a Zombie.
Whenever another creature you control dies, create a Treasure token.

rulings.quote: Once you've cast Gravecrawler and it's on the stack, it doesn't matter if you lose control of the other Zombie.

spellbook.quote: Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.

source.item: Rooftop Storm plus Gravecrawler
Phyrexian Altar plus Pitiless Plunderer plus Gravecrawler
Warren Soultrader plus Gravecrawler drain loop

interactions.title: Reassembling Skeleton loops without a Zombie
interactions.ruling: Reassembling Skeleton returns for {1}{B}. Ashnod's Altar ({C}{C}) or Phyrexian Altar ({1}) plus Plunderer's Treasure pays for it, for unbounded death triggers and mana. With Soultrader, two Treasures per loop (Soultrader + Plunderer) do the same, and Zulaport or Blood Artist drains.

spellbook.quote: Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.

interactions.title: Torpor Orb and Karn: what the list gave up
interactions.ruling: Torpor Orb and Karn shut off creature enter triggers for everyone, including yours. The source cut its own enter-trigger creatures for that reason (Fleshbag Marauder, Plaguecrafter and others). The remaining engines run on death, token, upkeep and graveyard triggers. Treasures and other artifacts entering under Karn don't trigger anything either. Muddle the Mixture (mana value 2) transmutes for Torpor Orb, Phyresis, Brotherhood Regalia and the other two-drops.

rulings.quote: Replacement effects, such as a permanent entering the battlefield tapped or with counters on it, are unaffected. Abilities that apply "as [this permanent] enters" are replacement effects.
